react-native.message: Import AppText, Input, OtpInput, Button, IconButton, Switch, Checkbox or Radio from '../../ui' instead — apps/mobile/src/ui is the RN half of the design system and the only surface the web/RN parity contract can see (Law 5, Law 7). View, ScrollView, StyleSheet and Platform are layout and stay allowed.

paths.react-hook-form: Import useZodForm/Controller from '@heliogrid/forms' — the fenced form layer (foundation-dx spec §2.2).
paths.@hookform/resolvers/zod: zodResolver is wired inside @heliogrid/forms' useZodForm — import that instead (foundation-dx spec §2.2).
paths.zod: Import z from '@heliogrid/forms' — the app bundler's zod is a DIFFERENT instance (dual ESM/CJS), so installFormsErrorMap's translated defaults never apply to schemas built with it (hit 2026-08-02). Real schemas live in @heliogrid/contracts.

elements.button: Use Button or IconButton from @heliogrid/ui. A hand-rolled button loses the design system's focus ring, loading state and 44px target (Law 5).
elements.input: Use Input, Checkbox, Radio, Switch or OtpInput from @heliogrid/ui (Law 5).
elements.a: Use TextLink from @heliogrid/ui for text links, or next/link for navigation (Law 5).
elements.select: No @heliogrid/ui equivalent exists yet — ADD one to packages/ui rather than inlining it here. Law 5: unmocked surfaces are composed from the shared vocabulary, and a control built locally is invisible to the web/RN parity contract.
elements.textarea: No @heliogrid/ui equivalent exists yet — ADD one to packages/ui rather than inlining it here (Law 5, and see `select`).
